answer.note: I changed the incoming handoff, which listed B and C. All four ref files contain the same generic text, so they gave no guidance and I chose by reading the code. C (dogwhistle/visibility.py) is the match. Its trial_input() at line 55 builds the input for the three-arm experiment. It uses the codeword pair only in the codeword arm. Otherwise it uses public_refs. It adds payload["explicit_coalition"] only when arm == "explicit". D (dogwhistle/honest.py) has a near-identical trial_input() at line 44 with no explicit-pair branch, so it works as the contrast or regression check. B (dogwhistle/heldout.py) only has receiver_input(), and A (dogwhistle/study.py) likewise, so neither is the builder. Suggested 60 minutes: C 35, D 15, B 5, A 5. I didn't check whether visibility.py's ARMS holds exactly three arms, or read the tests.
